db:insert.doc:name: Insert dead_letter_events
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO dead_letter_events (event_id, correlation_id, source_queue, reason, transient_retries, original_payload, failed_at) VALUES (:eventId, :correlationId, :sourceQueue, :reason, :retries, :payload, :failedAt)

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'DLQ_WRITE_FAILED type=' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ ' -> requeue to DLQ']

db:select.doc:name: Count OPEN dead letters
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dead_letter_events WHERE status = 'OPEN'

when.expression: #[(vars.dlqRows[0].cnt as Number) > (p('monitor.dlqThreshold') as Number) and not vars.dlqCooling]

email:body.email:content: Payment events could not be processed. See table dead_letter_events (status = OPEN) for the recorded reason of each.
